free_tier_limits: 25 requests/day on the unauthenticated public endpoint (approximately 1,500/month); no credit card required.
rate_limits: Free: soft limit of 25 requests/day, resetting daily, with limited/shared concurrency. Pro: unlimited daily quota and 46,000–420,000 requests/month. Enterprise: millions+. Quota exhaustion returns HTTP 429 with code ERATE.

description: Microlink turns URLs into normalized metadata and can generate screenshots, PDFs, HTML, Markdown, text, media, and structured data. Its REST API uses GET requests through two endpoints: api.microlink.io for unauthenticated free use and pro.microlink.io for authenticated plans.
resolution_notes: free_tier_limits: 50/day is wrong; Free is 25/day: https://microlink.io/pricing. rate_limits: pricing and 429 behavior confirmed at https://microlink.io/pricing and https://microlink.io/docs/guides/common/production-patterns. example: free endpoint must omit x-api-key; current curl/response are documented at https://microlink.io/docs/api/parameters/meta. description: “single endpoint” is wrong; two GET endpoints are documented at https://microlink.io/docs/api/basics/endpoint.
